contributions.statement: Before codifying a repeated agent procedure into a deterministic script, count the cost of failed codification attempts and the number of future uses; measured payback was 2-16 uses, and failed attempts cost several times a successful one.
contributions.evidence: Table 1: payback 1.39-15.5 uses; only 11/20 compilation cells pass verification; failed attempts ~6.6x successful (DeepSeek median); Table 4 ablation: equal-attempt-cost accounting +23% cost, no savings test +53% (simulation on recorded arrivals).
relative_to: P28 recipe/codemod codification (adds payback accounting incl. failed attempts)

contributions.statement: A cumulative cost budget relative to agent-only execution bounds worst-case overspend of a compile-or-run policy.
contributions.evidence: Theorem 4.1; all 4,800 grid and 120 log runs within 1.25x; removing the budget barely changes mean cost (0.0013%).

reason: GUI domain and simulated savings, but the payback measurement including failed attempts is a transferable cost rule for deciding when to turn agent workflows into scripts or recipes.
